item.title: Poynters Named Indiana’s 2025 Farm Family Of The Year
item.description: The Poynters of Putnam County are this year’s Farm Family of the Year, an award sponsored by Indiana AgriNews and Beck’s Hybrids.

item.title: 2026 Night To Shine Planned For Feb. 13 At Warsaw Church
item.description: Warsaw Evangelical Presbyterian Church announced Monday, Jan. 12, that it will serve as a host of the 2026 Night to Shine, sponsored by the Tim Tebow Foundation.

item.title: ‘Let-Kids-Be-Kids’ Bill Clears Indiana House Committee With Bipartisan Support
item.description: A bill to shield Hoosier parents from child welfare investigations solely for allowing their children age-appropriate independence cleared the House Judiciary Committee on Monday, Jan. 12 with bipartisan support.

item.title: Warsaw Library Board Hears Report On 2025 Statistics
item.description: The Warsaw Community Public Library Board of Trustees heard a report on year-end statistics for the library during a meeting on Monday, Jan. 12.

item.title: Leesburg Town Council Addresses Dog Complaint
